summary: Amends a Specific Plan and rezones from RS5 to SP about 2.38 acres at 905 and 907 West Eastland Avenue, 930 and 930 C McFerrin Avenue, and 609 through 645 Richmond Bend, to allow 19 residential units and up to 3,250 square feet of non-residential uses. Short term rentals are prohibited, and the commercial uses are limited to one labeled building.
